object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Edit an object's description and create an object, without committing. Expected: From and To both offer the working copy. With From = latest commit and To = working copy, the edited object is Modified with its uncommitted text at To, and the new object is Added. With From = working copy and To = latest commit, the edited object is Modified with its uncommitted text at From, and the new object is Deleted.
